title: Zesty Buttery Italian Almonds Saltimbocca
description: A light and crunchy Italian dish featuring nuts in a saltimbocca form, served on a lazy-susan-spinner, dairy-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced almonds to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the oil mixture.
Spread the almonds on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake the almonds in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the almonds from the oven and stir in the vegan butter until melted and well combined.
Allow the almonds to cool completely on the baking sheet.
Once cool, transfer the almonds to a lazy-susan-spinner and shape into a saltimbocca form.
